register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Join the community
register.birthDateHint: You must be at least {{age}} to use CardExchange. We never show it to other users.
register.birthDateRequired: Please enter your date of birth.
register.underage: You must be at least {{age}} to sign up to CardExchange.
register.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dot, hyphen and underscore (at least 3 characters).
register.usernameRule: Usernames can only contain letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores (3 to 50 characters).
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol (e.g. ! # . - @).

passwordProblem.length: Your password must be at least 8 characters long.
passwordProblem.upper: Your password must contain at least one uppercase letter.
passwordProblem.lower: Your password must contain at least one lowercase letter.
passwordProblem.digit: Your password must contain at least one number.
passwordProblem.symbol: Your password must contain at least one symbol (e.g. ! # . - @).

forgot.subtitle: Recover your password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.failed: Couldn't send the request. Please try again.

reset.subtitle: Set a new password
reset.passwordRule: Password must be at least 8 characters and include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol (e.g. ! # . - @).
reset.failed: Couldn't reset the password. Please try again.
reset.missingToken: Invalid link: the reset code is missing.

verify.subtitle: Email verification
verify.missingToken: Invalid link: the verification code is missing.
verify.resendHint: You can request a new link from the banner at the top of the app.

ageGate.title: Confirm your age
ageGate.body: To keep using CardExchange, please enter your date of birth. It lets us check you are at least {{age}}, as data protection law requires. We never show it to other users and it can't be changed later.
ageGate.underage: You must be at least {{age}} to use CardExchange.
ageGate.failed: Your date couldn't be saved. Please try again.
